subject.title: feat(plugins): upgrade llm_input/llm_output hooks from fire-and-forget to modifying

question: Should modifying LLM interception use new or versioned hooks, or should maintainers intentionally replace the shipped observer-only `llm_input` and `llm_output` contract?
rationale: The proposal permanently changes a public plugin API's timing, authority, failure behavior, and cross-runner semantics; implementation review cannot safely choose that contract direction.

options.title: Add separate modifier hooks
options.body: Preserve the existing observers and add clearly named, documented modifiers with complete runner parity.

options.title: Own a breaking upgrade
options.body: Convert the existing hooks only with explicit migration policy, all-runner support, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Decline interception
options.body: Retain observation-only model hooks and use narrower existing transformation seams.

recommendation.title: Add separate modifier hooks
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing observers and add clearly named, documented modifiers with complete runner parity.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the broadest active ownership across the central runner and plugin-hook decision surface.
